caseName: Town of E. Hampton v. Friends of the E. Hampton Airport, Inc.
caseNameFull: TOWN OF EAST HAMPTON, NEW YORK v. FRIENDS OF THE EAST HAMPTON AIRPORT, INC.

opinions.text: Motion of Committee to Stop Airport Expansion, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
